rules: Counting awards counts wins: Marie Curie, Bardeen, Sanger, Sharpless, the Red Cross (3x) and UNHCR (2x) appear more than once. Use COUNT(DISTINCT laureate_id) for people.
age_at_award, gender and birth_* are NULL for the 28 organisations; filter kind = 'person' for age or gender questions.
prizes includes 49 rows with is_awarded = 0 (wars, reserved years). Filter is_awarded = 1 when counting prizes.
Country = present-day country of birth (countryNow). birth_country_then keeps the historical name (Prussia, Russian Empire, Austria-Hungary).
